parsed.why: State courts repeatedly enjoin anti-trans statutes (2023 sex-binary law struck down, facilities ban restrained, care ban struck down, marker blocks upheld), the only state improving in 2026. But national passport/entry-screening exposure and hostile 2026 law in litigation cap the upside.

Most Protective tier: no facilities ban, gender-identity hate-crime and public-accommodation protections, X markers, healthcare shield law for visitors. National passport/entry-screening restrictions still apply, limiting how high it can sit.

Worst Policies In Effect: K-12 and minor-present bathroom ban with a misdemeanour trigger, first-in-country youth care ban now enforceable after appellate reversal, no state hate-crime or discrimination protection, X licence markers rescinded. State hostility layered on the national regime.

Worst-tier state: sweeping sex-definition statute reaching restrooms, shelters, dormitories and prisons, religious-refusal shield, no state discrimination or hate-crime protection, narrow marker route upheld against a post-surgery applicant. Broad universal facility/custody exposure.

Worst-tier state: 2025 facilities law segregating all public restrooms, changing and sleeping quarters with a private cause of action against permitted access, schools included; no state nondiscrimination or hate-crime law; surgery-plus-court-order birth-certificate rule. Heavy universal exclusion.
